blocks.text: The Lord Jesus calls us the light of the world - {{mt 5:14,mt 5:15,mt 5:16|Matthew 5:14-16}} - the salt of the earth - {{mt 5:13|Matthew 5:13}} - and ambassadors of Christ - {{jo 20:21|John 20:21}}. These titles carry weight: they mean we matter to God, and our responsibilities are significant. To discharge them well - without failing God or disappointing the Pastor who recommended us - every worker is expected to observe the following code of conduct.
A worker must be totally submissive to the constituted authorities of the Mission - {{1pe 5:5|1 Peter 5:5}}; {{1co 16:16|1 Corinthians 16:16}}; {{hb 13:17|Hebrews 13:17}}. In practice, this means:

items: Informing the Pastor before travelling - {{2kgs 6:2|2 Kings 6:2}}.
Being ready to attend all meetings and go wherever sent - {{js 1:16|Joshua 1:16}}.
Being absolutely obedient to Pastors and Assistant Pastors when their instructions don't contradict Scripture - {{1pe 5:5|1 Peter 5:5}}.
Being an example to the congregation in submitting to the doctrine of the church - {{tt 2:7|Titus 2:7}}; {{1tm 4:6,1tm 4:12|1 Timothy 4:6, 12}}; {{tt 1:9|Titus 1:9}}.
Being an example in spending and being spent for God - {{2co 12:15|2 Corinthians 12:15}}; {{gl 2:20|Galatians 2:20}}.

blocks.text: Beyond submission, a worker is also expected to be hygienic in every disposition - {{is 52:11|Isaiah 52:11}}; to dress modestly and scripturally, giving God the benefit of any doubt - {{1pe 3:1,1pe 3:2,1pe 3:3,1pe 3:4|1 Peter 3:1-4}}, {{1tm 2:9|1 Timothy 2:9}}, {{is 3:16,is 3:17,is 3:18,is 3:19,is 3:20,is 3:21,is 3:22,is 3:23,is 3:24,is 3:25,is 3:26|Isaiah 3:16-26}}; and to represent both Christ and the church so well that if transferred to a town with no branch of the church, they would promptly start one - {{act 8:4|Acts 8:4}}; {{act 11:19|Acts 11:19}}.

A worker should be glad to attend all-night vigils, or organise them at home - {{lk 6:12|Luke 6:12}}; {{act 16:25|Acts 16:25}}; punctual at every Local, Area, Zonal, Provincial, or National meeting - {{hb 10:25|Hebrews 10:25}}; and constantly walking, worshipping, and growing in the Spirit - {{gl 5:16|Galatians 5:16}}; {{jo 4:23,jo 4:24|John 4:23-24}}; {{cl 3:16|Colossians 3:16}}.

A worker should enjoy a life of holiness and sanctification - living rightly both in public and in private, and dwelling in love - {{2pe 3:18|2 Peter 3:18}}; {{2tm 3:14,2tm 3:15,2tm 3:16,2tm 3:17|2 Timothy 3:14-17}}; {{eph 5:25,eph 5:26,eph 5:27|Ephesians 5:25-27}}; {{mt 5:13,mt 5:14,mt 5:15,mt 5:16|Matthew 5:13-16}}; {{hb 12:14|Hebrews 12:14}}; {{1tm 3:2|1 Timothy 3:2}}.

Finally, a worker should always be ready to do good works - {{tt 2:14|Titus 2:14}}; {{gl 6:10|Galatians 6:10}} - and should be ever watchful to protect the good name of the church - {{1tm 3:7|1 Timothy 3:7}}; {{tt 1:10,tt 1:11,tt 1:12,tt 1:13|Titus 1:10-13}}.
